note: Close requests asked for by hand from the live dashboard's Open positions table. Each row is one ticket and the moment a reader asked for it. The five-minute loop reads this file from the published branch on its next tick and takes out only a ticket carrying its own magic, and only while the row is younger than thirty minutes; an older row is left alone, because a position opened since must not be closed by an ask nobody meant for it. The dashboard writes this file with the reader's own GitHub token, through the same contents API calls the marked-levels file uses. This file is a request, not an order: nothing in it places, changes or closes anything on its own.
